name: Consensus row and agent implied row both render with percentages
description: Beneath the per-book table the Odds tab must show a market consensus row and the agent's own implied-probability row side by side, each as concrete home/draw/away percentages, so a visitor can compare the market against the agent's pick without doing math.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage and open a match detail page

Verify the tab renders a labeled market consensus row AND a separate agent implied-probability row, each showing concrete home, draw and away percentages (e.g. 'Home 42% · Draw 26% · Away 32%'). Both rows must carry real numbers; a missing agent row, a missing consensus row, or placeholder/blank percentages fail.
